scope: All72 recent completed league games, three frozen rounds. Retrospective descriptive; appearances share games, teammate and opponent strata separated. Other-player VM failures are part of this live field, not clean comparative efficacy. No source, forecast or proxy.
limits: XP from eventually failed player slots cannot be assigned to post-failure periods without exact failure timing.
Conditioning on selected class is not a draft intervention: hero availability, seats, teams and opponents differ.
Drought and no-target counters do not by themselves identify a bad decision or affordable alternative.
No confidence interval treats shared-game hero appearances as independent.
